# Nervecept Notebook (nervecept.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Nervecept, a once-daily capsule marketed to support nerve sensitivity, nerve function and comfort in the hands and feet in adults. 30 capsules a bottle; one capsule daily with 8 oz of water, 20 to 30 minutes before a meal. Label (per capsule): glucosamine sulfate 500 mg, Indian frankincense (Boswellia serrata) 67 mg, chondroitin sulfate 50 mg, turmeric root 50 mg, quercetin 8 mg, methionine 8 mg, MSM 8 mg, bromelain 8 mg; other ingredients hypromellose capsule and rice flour; CONTAINS SHELLFISH (CRAYFISH). Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping); 60-day money-back guarantee by email, bottles returned full, partly used or empty.

IMPORTANT: Nervecept is a supplement, not a treatment, cure or repair for neuropathy or nerve damage; its ingredients are a classic joint-comfort set and most amounts are far below studied doses. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Contains shellfish. Several ingredients may affect bleeding, blood sugar or medicine absorption; ask a doctor first with blood thinners, diabetes medicine, antibiotics or chemotherapy. Numbness, tingling or burning need a medical assessment. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people should consult a physician. Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, a drooping face, trouble speaking or breathing.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
